question: How can I configure my SDK to use nested groups for method names like client.admin.users.create() instead of the default naming convention?
ground_truth: To configure nested groups in your SDK, you can use the x-fern-sdk-group-name extension with an array of group names in your OpenAPI specification. For example, to generate client.admin.users.create(), you would add x-fern-sdk-group-name: ["admin", "users"] and x-fern-sdk-method-name: create to your endpoint definition. The SDK will preserve the order of group names and automatically handle the appropriate casing for each language (camelCase for TypeScript, snake_case for Python, PascalCase for Go, etc.).

metadata.cited_context:
If you add more than one `x-fern-sdk-group-name` extension, then the generated SDK will nest group names. The generated SDK method preserves the order of group names. In the example below, Fern will generate a method called `client.users.notifications.send()`:

```yaml title="openapi.yaml"
paths:
  /users/notifications:
    post:
      x-fern-sdk-group-name:
        - users
        - notifications
      x-fern-sdk-method-name: send
```
